answer: Farming becomes an opal bet on surviving 65 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the orchard schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 65 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
